documentation.content: Runbook row: API request failures (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. This condition uses the AlertPolicy REST v3 MetricThreshold's native denominatorFilter/denominatorAggregations fields to alert directly on the runbook's 5xx-count/total-count ratio, no query-language condition needed. The runbook's proposed floor (total >= 20 requests in the window) is not separately enforced: the ratio is undefined (no data point) at zero traffic, but a handful of requests can still produce a triggering ratio at very low volume. Initial, review after 7 days once real traffic volume is known.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.service_name="chirp-api" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"
conditionThreshold.denominatorFilter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.service_name="chirp-api" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count"
